First income year 2022: 0001925531-23-000003 (10-K, 2022-12-31) 'Since the Company commenced operations on May 9, 2022' and 'Total investment income 5,877'; the 10-Qs print 709 (quarter to 2022-06-30) and 2,004 (quarter to 2022-09-30), so the fourth quarter is 5,877 less 2,713 = 3,164; it had been published as 5,877 x 3/8 = 2,204.
